active_yaml:
models:
- metaclip2_vith14
- dfn5b_vith14
- siglip2_so400m
inference:
  image_text_relation:
    enabled: false
    mode: auto
    weight: 0.25
  batch_size: 16
  image_weight: 0.5
  text_logit_scale: null
datasets:
  fakeddit:
    image_text_relation:
      mode: auto
    enabled: false
    task: 6way
    data_path: data/processed/pro_fakeddit/fakeddit_sample.tsv
    image_dir: data/processed/pro_fakeddit/images
    id_col: id
    text_col: clean_title
    label_col_2way: 2_way_label
    label_col_6way: 6_way_label
    min_text_length: 20
    max_samples: 1000
    prompt_aggregation: mean_sim
    prompt_variants:
    - current
    inference:
      image_weight: 0.75
      text_logit_scale: 25
  crisismmd:
    image_text_relation:
      mode: auto
    enabled: true
    task: informativeness
    data_path: data/processed/pro_crisismmd/pre_crisismmd.tsv
    image_dir: data/processed/pro_crisismmd/images
    id_col: tweet_id
    text_col: clean_text
    label_col_info: label_informative
    label_col_human: label_humanitarian
    max_samples: 2
    prompt_aggregation: mean_embed
    inference:
      image_weight: 0.5
      text_logit_scale: null
    prompt_aggregations:
    - mean_embed
  mmimdb:
    image_text_relation:
      mode: auto
    enabled: false
    task: genres
    data_path: data/processed/pro_mmimdb/mmimdb_sample.tsv
    image_dir: data/processed/pro_mmimdb/images
    id_col: id
    text_col: plot
    label_col: genres
    max_samples: 1000
    prompt_aggregation: mean_sim
    decision_mode: relative_z
    relative_z_threshold: 1.0
    threshold: 0.22
    chunk_long_text: true
    chunk_aggregation: mean_embed
    inference:
      image_weight: 0.5
      text_logit_scale: null
evaluation:
  enabled: true
  split: val
  measure_truncation: true
  sample_lock_mode: 'off'
  sample_lock_dir: results/sample_locks
demo:
  n_samples: 10
  batch_size: 4
  prompt_version: v1
  log_dir: results/demo_logs
  visualization_dir: results/demo
output:
  results_dir: results/runs/crisismmd_info/3f7d7eff38d3
  raw_predictions_dir: results/runs/crisismmd_info/3f7d7eff38d3/raw_predictions
  summary_table: results/runs/crisismmd_info/3f7d7eff38d3/summary_table.tsv
job_yaml:
enabled: true
kind: standard
dataset: crisismmd
task: informativeness
max_samples: 2
models:
- metaclip2_vith14
- dfn5b_vith14
- siglip2_so400m
prompt_aggregations:
- mean_embed
ensemble:
  enabled: false
  methods:
  - equal_mean
  - margin_gate
  margin_threshold: 0.1
id: crisismmd_info
output_dir: results/runs/crisismmd_info/3f7d7eff38d3
